title: Introduction: The Greatest Show On Earth
supportedClaims: Money works like a behavioral subject before it works like a spreadsheet problem.
The chapter opens by showing that decisions happen around identity, memory, ego, and incentives, so neat formulas rarely survive contact with life unchanged.
Readers are asked to judge habits, narratives, and incentives together instead of acting as if information automatically produces good behavior.
caution: The point is not that arithmetic is useless, but that arithmetic lives inside a human temperament that can amplify or cancel it.
